propositions: review-bot receiver logs the authentication token in plaintext in uvicorn access logs when the token is passed as a query parameter (?token=...)
logged tokens flow to journald and any log-grepping tools, exposing a credential that can authenticate both webhook and rerun endpoints and act as the bot against Gerrit
the webhook and rerun handlers accept the secret via query string, which is recorded in the request line by uvicorn's default access log formatter
the authentication token must be moved from the query string to an HTTP header (X-Rebar-Token) so uvicorn access logs do not record it, with a redaction filter as a backstop
the previously-logged token is treated as compromised and must be rotated independently of the code fix, with rotation tracked and attested separately
access logs must continue to record route and status for observability and debugging, with only the credential value redacted
